shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -50 && printf '\\n--- skill ---\\n' && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- project files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | sort | head -100 && printf '\\n--- routing top ---\\n' && sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- App.tsx ---' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- main.tsx ---' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- index.css ---' && cat src/index.css && printf '%s\\n' '--- index.html ---' && cat index.html && printf '%s\\n' '--- skill step 1-3 ---' && sed -n '45,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/uikit'

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version\" && printf '\\n--- docs files ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*docs*INDEX.md' -o -name 'INDEX.md' | head -20 && printf '\\n--- inspect script ---\\n' && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Checkbox TextInput ThemeProvider"
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Checkbox TextInput ThemeProvider'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- required setup ---' && rg -n -C 6 'Required setup|@gravity-ui/uikit/styles|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120 && printf '%s\\n' '--- form docs ---' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -type f | rg 'TextInput|Checkbox|Button|Card|Form' | head -30 && printf '%s\\n' '--- types ---' && for f in node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,180p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md && printf '\\n--- Button types ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts && printf '\\n--- ControlProps ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 'interface ControlProps|export type ControlProps|type ControlSize' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/**/*.d.ts && printf '\\n--- Provider ---\\n' && rg -n -C 5 'export.*Provider|function Provider|interface Provider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme -S"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'export interface ControlProps|ControlSize|validationState|errorPlacement' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/*.d.ts | head -80 && printf '\\n--- Button props ---\\n' && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts && printf '\\n--- layout docs Box/Flex ---\\n' && rg -n -C 4 '"'^### Box|''^### Flex|className=|space='"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- Flex types ---' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- Box types ---' && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- Typography types ---' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Typography -name '*.d.ts' -maxdepth 2 -print -exec sed -n '1,160p' {} \\; && printf '%s\\n' '--- Typography docs ---' && rg -n -C 5 'Typography|variant' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/typography.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'Text|Heading|typography' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -60 && printf '\\n--- typography ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/typography.md && printf '\\n--- layout spacing values ---\\n' && rg -n -C 4 'spacing-[0-9]|gap=' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- Text types ---' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- Card types ---' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/types.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- Control types ---' && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- theming scope ---' && rg -n -C 5 'scoped|Provider|system' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts && printf '\\n--- theming scope ---\\n' && rg -n -C 4 'scoped|Provider|system' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -120 && printf '\\n--- text props ---\\n' && sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts && printf '\\n--- color props ---\\n' && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort && printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- src ---' && for f in src/*; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,220p' \""'$f"; done && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- configs ---' && for f in vite.config.* tsconfig*.json index.html; do [ -f \""'$f" ] && { echo "### $f"; cat "$f"; }; done'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; printf '\\n--- checkbox ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; printf '\\n--- button ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Flex style prop names ---\\n'; rg -o '"'^'"\\s{4}[a-zA-Z]+\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/hooks/useStyleProps.d.ts | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 80 'export interface BaseStyleProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/hooks/useStyleProps.d.ts | head -110; printf '\\n--- ControlProps ---\\n'; rg -n -A 25 'export interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- text docs title paragraphs ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/typography.md"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/App.tsx')
content = path.read_text()
content = content.replace('export function App() {\\n  return <main className=\"page\">{/* TODO */}</main>;\\n}\\n', '')
path.write_text(content)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e 's/export function App\\(\\) \\{\\n  return <main className=\"page\">\\{\\/\\* TODO \\*\\/\\}<\\/main>;\\n\\}\\n//' src/App.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.css ---\\n' && cat src/index.css"
